description: This header file defines data structures and function prototypes for managing a vector of subscription objects within a software system. It includes definitions of the 'subs_t' structure representing individual subscriptions and 'subs_vector_t' for managing collections of subscriptions, along with API functions for initializing, adding, removing, and destroying subscriptions.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a subscription to the subscriptions vector.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the subscriptions vector.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Deallocates memory associated with a subscriptions vector.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_GetSubsByInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription by its instance number.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_MarkSubscriptionForDeletion
methods.description: Marks a subscription for deletion, to be cleaned up later.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_GarbageCollectSubscriptions
methods.description: Removes subscriptions marked for deletion from the vector.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Outputs the current state of the subscription vector for debugging.
